comingLast.roast: a 2-marker at the bottom - the members' board did not see this coming
2 more points and the problem becomes Johnson's problem
on 21 - the two blue balls have begun their lap of honour early
Johnson is one good hole of his away from inheriting the lead nobody wants
in on 1 above the drop - his shout if he survives, tradition says
1 point of insurance at 1.4 a hole - premium unpaid
his lead over Johnson is 2 - a strong gust could move it
finished 3 clear of the blue balls - now buying Johnson drinks out of gratitude
finished with a 4-point buffer - his group is still reminding him hourly
